subject: Re: AE Position with Encord
text:
Hi Leo and Eric,

Thank you for your time today and for giving me the opportunity to come
meet you face to face. Quite refreshing being able to shake hands and see
the environment you're operating in day-to-day.

I thought our conversations today were productive and I appreciate the
opportunity to dig deeper into the items front of mind for me.

Eric - the insights you shared around your approach to building Encord in a
new market were great, the strict focus on execution and continually
delivering against the problem space for this category is a philosophy that
aligns closely with my way of thinking. Build the right solution, deliver
value, and growth will follow.

Leo - the tactical depth we went into was hugely helpful for visualising
what life as an AE at Encord really looks like. The outbound-heavy motion,
the expectation that AEs are technically strong enough to run self-managed
demos, and the need for autonomy from day one are all things I’m not only
comfortable with, but confident I can excel in. I also appreciated you
calling out the immediate challenges around discovery and improving
conversion from early-stage outbound calls; these are areas I’ve lived and
think I can add value to quickly.

I have reached out to my references so we can arrange calls with them for
next week (they are Sydney based so TZs is a point to consider). Will drop
you a note with their details as soon as that is confirmed.

Have a great weekend, and looking forward to closing this out soon.

Best Regards,
Chris
